intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “You. Onset was the moment you left last time.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “Symptoms. I look up whenever anyone walks toward me. Fourteen times so far. Twelve were Pim.”

intro.speaker: SENNA
intro.text: “One was a goose. I don’t want to discuss the goose.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: She opens her notebook to a page headed *Treatment* and waits, pencil ready.

options.labelText: “Same here. I kept turning to tell you things, and you weren’t there.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: Under *Treatment* she writes *Frequent doses.* She looks at it, crosses out *Frequent*, and writes *Daily.*

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “Now tell me the things. Oldest first.”

options.labelText: “Have you tried leeches? I hear Doctor Leeches swears by them.”

branch.speaker: SENNA
branch.text: “He’d prescribe six and a brisk walk.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: She closes the notebook. The *Treatment* page stays blank.
